Hi Commanders,

I’m now at day 3 of the development, the progress is excellent! I completed the following features:

  • Killboard (All your kill history is now available)
  • Corporation (Discord and Mumble integration)

In my previous post, I mentioned having difficulties with displaying existing fitting, I finally figured out how to pull the data and that section is completed.

The Fitting Simulator is one hell of a challenge, but I almost finished. It’s one of the last features to work on before I officially release the app. So here’s what you can expect:

  • Meet your new buddy, BOB The builder, an advanced AI with full knowledge of your character for better situation awareness, better recommendation and optimized fit based on your needs. BOB has been injected with everything there is to know about EVE Online (this poor thing has been studying hard).
  • All ships, modules, rigs, drones, charges are cached into our server to increase browsing experience while you or BOB build your next ship.
  • Intuitive UI with full visibility on all statistics there is to know.

What there’s left for me to do with the Fitting Simulator is inject more data into our poor BOB. My goal is that when BOB suggest you a fit, the fit shows in a confirmation box in where you will agree or not to push to the simulator. Once it’s pushed, BOB will read through all the statistics of the ships including the modules AND also take into consideration all your skills level that could increase the base stats and make sure the suggested fitting is optimal. BOB will automatically detect if the CPU or Powergrid exceeded and will push another fit that’s more tailored to your skill. If BOB find that the capacitor is unreasonably low (will depletes fast), BOB will adjust the fitting once more without your intervention.

I hope you’ll enjoy using the fitting simulator as I spent 80% of my time on that section and there was a lot of bad words that came out of my mouth many time, I can tell you that hehe.

Lastly, I’ll adjust the other AI that I made specifically for the entire app. Just like BOB, Aura knows everything about every characters you linked on the app and also knows everything there is to know about EVE Online. It is an advance AI System in which I integrated about 11 different LLM services, so Aura knows more than just EVE Online. If you feel bored, just enjoy talking about all and everything to Aura.

Aura’s limitations are simple, it cannot push a recommended fit to the fitting simulator, for that, speak to BOB

I’m expecting to finish everything by tomorrow, so stay tuned!

posts.name: Syzygium
posts.cooked: is it possible to select what access the app can have? For example if I want to be able to track my skill queue and notifications but not allow the app to read my assets, mails or location?

posts.name: IIBankII
posts.cooked:
Hi @Syzygium ,

That’s a legitimate question and let me be clear on what access our app has in memory.

When you authenticate with our app, you authorize the app to pull data through EVE ESI on your behalf for the different features our app offers. All informations that are shown to you are saved locally on your device and dies when you clear you cache or sign out.

While you do allow the app to fetch data through the ESI Connector that you authorized the app to access, it is simply used as a connector to the various section of our app. None of the data are stored on the server.

Here’s the “BUT”, the only data that is temporarily stored are the chats you had with “Aura” and “Bob”. If you ask Aura if there’s any mails today, and there was, Aura will write a resume of your email(s). That email would technically be temporarily store in our Encrypted Data Blob (EDB). If you don’t want those data to touch our server, you could avoid chatting with Aura and Bob or avoid asking sensitive questions to either of them.

The other information that’s stored on EVE ONE’s EDB is the items that you marked as “Favorite” on the market. That isn’t particularly sensitive. That information has to be saved in order to synchronize your “Watch List / Favorite” to your other devices.

So, to answer your question, the app doesn’t have the option to select which permissions you wish to grant or not as this would severely impact the experience you have with the app and go against the idea of “All-In-One”.

You can read more about how your data are handle on the privacy page:

EVE ONE - Privacy Policy

I hope this answered your question and even better, reassured you on the data that is saved temporarily on the EDB.

posts.name: Syzygium
posts.cooked:
IIBankII:

So, to answer your question, the app doesn’t have the option to select which permissions you wish to grant or not as this would severely impact the experience you have with the app and go against the idea of “All-In-One”.

Thanks, that was all I needed to know.

My concern is that any developer of an app can tell me as really non-skilled end-user whatever he wants and I have no way to prove or disprove it.
So, the only way to make sure no app can read or store my mails or location is to not grant it that API/ESI access. Because after your app has the data, I have no way to reliably control where that data goes, no matter what the dev is telling me.

No offense, good luck with your project I just wanted to be clear about that point.

  • 3.6 Market: This feature allows you to scan opportunities from the market, find blueprints that are the most rewarding, and add blueprints in your watchlist.

  • 3.7 Analytics: This feature allows you to have an overview of your expenses and profits directly related to the jobs you made.

  • 3.8 Structures: This feature allows you to quickly see which of your corporation / alliance structure offers which bonuses for industry jobs.

  • 3.9 Changes to Privacy Policy for EVEO Industry: All blueprints that were added to the user’s watchlist will be saved into our database to allow synchronization of that watchlist with the user’s devices.

  1. UPDATE Aura: Inject EVEO Intelligence public data and user’s cache data into Aura. This will allow you to leverage the power of AI to analyze your current abilities and ships and propose you the recommended action against the enemy you seek to fight from your report or Pilot Intel.

  2. UPD-MAJOR_UPDATE: Corporation

  • 5.1 The whole Corporation section will completely be revamped with more tools for members and directors. Features for members like better integration with various communication tools, and features for directors like “Memo” that will be shown to all members of their corporation once they sign in, various trackers to see their members participation, and so on…

  • 5.2 Corporation Public Invite: Corporation CEO will have the possibility to list publicly their corporation recruitment information.

  • 5.2 Privately Policy: Memos made by corporation director will be saved into our database in order to synchronized on all of their members portal. Corporation Recruitment post will also be saved into our database in order to be synchronized on all accounts.

Please do not hesitate to send me your feedback or suggestions, this will help me shape the app better.
